body:
Source: GitHub issue #595 (bug, security, P1-high). Re-verified on main @ de8a130a: packages/coldstart/lib/gate.mjs:163-165 `defaultLoadCacheEntries` returns `loadFiltered({ ticket, dir }).entries` — a lenient read with no signature check and with `.skipped` discarded — and `checkAll` (gate.mjs:126-159) serves `{ cached: true }` from any entry `findCachedVerdict` matches. Repro: a hand-written, UNSIGNED ledger line `{"seq":1,"gate":"coldstart","ts":"<now>","ticket":"T1","data":{"cache":{"ticketHash":"<ticketHash(T1)>","model":"<resolveExpectedModel('cheap')>","gaps":[]}},"files":{},"prev":null}` makes `checkAll([T1],'cheap',{dir})` return `cached: true, gaps: []` with no provider call; the CLI prints `[PASS] T1 … (cached)` and exits 0. The ledger is committed repo content, so the artifact under review supplies the evidence the gate trusts.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package `packages/coldstart`: bin/coldstart.mjs (CLI; already imports `getKey` from `@adlc/gate-manifest/lib/sign.mjs` and passes `key: getKey()` to every record() call at :109 and :169; calls `checkAll(targets, tier, { force, maxAgeMs, dir: undefined })` at :149), lib/gate.mjs (checkAll, checkTicket, defaultLoadCacheEntries, checkAllOffline), lib/cache.mjs (findCachedVerdict, buildCacheData), lib/verdict.mjs (--prompt-only --record-verdict path), lib/report.mjs, lib/prompt.mjs, lib/normalize-gaps.mjs, lib/cli-options.mjs. Signature primitives live in `packages/gate-manifest/lib/sign.mjs`: `getKey(env)`, `verifyEntrySig(key, entry)` (constant-time; false when `sig` missing/malformed/wrong), `KEY_ENV = 'ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY'`. `loadFiltered` (gate-manifest/lib/show.mjs) returns `{ entries, skipped }`; `skipped` items are `{ segment, line, error }`. Tests: `npm test -w packages/coldstart` from the worktree root. Existing tests that may change (they are NOT rails): test/checkall-cache.test.mjs (injects loadCacheEntriesFn — keep its injected-ledger style for the new test) and test/coldstart-cache-e2e.test.mjs (currently records with `key: null` and expects a cache hit — that expectation pins the defect; rewrite it to record under a key and pass the same key to checkAll, and say so in the PR body). In this repository all 27 committed coldstart entries are signed, so the change costs no cache hits here. Consumers of coldstart evidence: packages/runner/lib/assertions.mjs (p0 presence/shape check of the LATEST coldstart entry — it does not read the cache and must keep passing; run `node --test packages/runner/test/*.test.mjs`), packages/cli/lib/registry.mjs (dispatch only).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. ONE exported pure function in lib/cache.mjs, `trustedCacheEntries(entries, { key })`, is the only filter between the ledger and `findCachedVerdict`: it returns the subset of `entries` for which `verifyEntrySig(key, entry)` is true; when `key` is null/undefined/empty it returns `[]` (no key means the cache is UNAVAILABLE, never trusted). It never mutates its input.
2. `checkAll` accepts `opts.key` (default `null`) and `opts.loadCacheEntriesFn` now returns `{ entries, skipped }` (the default reads `loadFiltered` and returns both). For each ticket the cache candidates are `trustedCacheEntries(entries, { key })`. A verdict served from an entry that failed verification, or served with no key, is a defect.
3. `checkAll`'s result objects gain `cacheSkipped: <number>` = the count of `skipped` items the ledger read reported for that ticket's lookup (0 when the cache was not consulted). bin/coldstart.mjs passes `key: getKey()` to `checkAll` and, when the sum of `cacheSkipped` is > 0, prints ONE stderr line `coldstart: <n> unreadable manifest line(s) were skipped while reading the verdict cache` (exit code unchanged). When `getKey()` is null and the cache would otherwise have been consulted, bin prints ONE stderr line `coldstart: ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY is not set — cached verdicts are not trusted; re-auditing` once per run, not per ticket. Nothing new on stdout; `--json` output shape only gains the `cacheSkipped` field.
4. Regression guards: `--force` still bypasses the cache; the `ADLC_GATE_MOCK_RESPONSE` test seam still never reads the cache; `--max-age` semantics unchanged; `checkAllOffline` unchanged; record() calls unchanged.
5. Documentation: in `packages/coldstart/README.md` (the Caching section around lines 81-99) and by hand in `apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/coldstart.mdx`, add the statement that a cached verdict is honoured only when its ledger entry carries a valid signature under `ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY`, that without the key the cache is bypassed and the ticket is re-audited, and that unreadable ledger lines are reported on stderr. Never regenerate the mdx.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 An unsigned entry whose ticketHash/model match is NOT served: `checkAll` calls `checkTicketFn` and returns `cached: false`. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/cache-signature-required.test.mjs`
- AC2 An entry with a sig that does not verify under the supplied key (wrong key, or tampered `data.cache.gaps` after signing) is NOT served. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/cache-signature-required.test.mjs`
- AC3 A correctly signed entry under the supplied key IS served (`cached: true`, provider not called) — the fix does not disable caching. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/cache-signature-required.test.mjs`
- AC4 With `key: null` and a correctly signed entry present, the cache is not consulted (`cached: false`, provider called). verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/cache-signature-required.test.mjs`
- AC5 `trustedCacheEntries` returns a new array, never the input array, and `[]` for a missing key; `cacheSkipped` equals the skipped count the loader reported. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/cache-signature-required.test.mjs`
- AC6 End to end through the real ledger: record() under a key, then checkAll with the same key → cached; a second ledger line appended by hand without a sig for a different ticket → that ticket re-audits. verify: `node --test packages/coldstart/test/coldstart-cache-e2e.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing suite green, including the rewritten e2e test and test/checkall-cache.test.mjs (pass a key + sign fixtures, or inject trusted entries — state which in the PR body). verify: `npm test -w packages/coldstart`
- AC8 Runner p0 assertions unaffected. verify: `node --test packages/runner/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC9 Docs updated in both places. verify: `grep -c "valid signature" packages/coldstart/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/coldstart.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC10 Mutation gate green on the branch. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also run `--max 80` once locally before review)

OUT OF SCOPE: chain (prev-hash) verification of the whole ledger on the cache path — `verify()` is a separate, slower trust decision and is not required for a per-entry cache check; the `--prompt-only --record-verdict` write path (lib/verdict.mjs); issues #596/#597 (coldstart docs drift) beyond the Caching paragraph named above.
title: coldstart: serve a cached verdict only from a signature-verified manifest entry
